auto-mechanical.about: Build skills to inspect, maintain and repair the mechanical systems of light vehicles.
auto-mechanical.skills: Engines • Brakes • Steering and suspension • Diagnostic tools • Safe servicing
auto-mechanical.suit: People interested in how cars work who enjoy practical tasks and careful fault-finding.
auto-mechanical.use: Use workshop procedures for routine maintenance, component checks and mechanical repairs.
auto-mechanical.jobs: Motor mechanic • Light vehicle repair technician • Vehicle service technician

auto-management.about: Develop the operational and people-management skills used in an automotive service business.
auto-management.skills: Workshop planning • Team leadership • Customer service • Business operations
auto-management.suit: Learners seeking supervisory responsibilities or a pathway from technical work into management.
auto-management.use: Apply planning and communication skills to coordinate workshop staff and improve service operations. Package study options are available.
auto-management.jobs: Workshop supervisor • Service coordinator • Automotive business manager, with relevant experience

auto-diagnosis.about: Develop a structured approach to diagnosing more complex automotive mechanical faults.
auto-diagnosis.skills: Diagnostic strategies • Test results • Complex faults • Technical reporting
auto-diagnosis.suit: Learners who have an automotive mechanical Certificate III or can demonstrate equivalent competency.
auto-diagnosis.use: Use advanced fault-finding methods to support repair decisions and technical work in a service workshop.
auto-diagnosis.jobs: Diagnostic technician • Senior automotive technician, depending on prior experience

short-sithfab021.about: Learn responsible alcohol service and how to recognise and respond to unsafe service situations.
short-sithfab021.skills: Responsible service • Customer communication • State-specific responsibilities
short-sithfab021.suit: Adults considering work in licensed hospitality or retail venues.
short-sithfab021.use: Apply responsible service practices in venues that sell or supply alcohol.
short-sithfab021.jobs: Hospitality service or licensed retail roles, subject to local licensing and employer requirements.

short-sithgam022.about: Learn responsible gambling service practices and how to support customers who may be experiencing harm.
short-sithgam022.skills: Responsible service • Recognising harm • Customer support procedures
short-sithgam022.suit: Adults considering customer-facing roles in licensed gaming venues.
short-sithgam022.use: Use venue procedures to assist customers and meet role-specific responsibilities.
short-sithgam022.jobs: Gaming-area service roles in licensed venues; state requirements apply.

short-cpcwhs1001.about: Build basic construction-site safety awareness, including hazards, protective equipment and incident reporting.
short-cpcwhs1001.skills: Hazard recognition • Protective equipment • Emergency procedures
short-cpcwhs1001.suit: People preparing for work that requires construction induction training.
short-cpcwhs1001.use: Understand basic safe-work practices before entering construction environments.
short-cpcwhs1001.jobs: Construction-site roles with appropriate trade skills and required permissions.

short-hlthps006.about: Explore medication assistance, supporting self-administration and completing related records within an authorised support role.
short-hlthps006.suit: Health and community-service workers whose role permits medication assistance.
short-hlthps006.use: Support an existing care role within workplace procedures and state requirements.
short-hlthps006.jobs: A skill addition for authorised care roles; this unit does not confer nursing registration.

short-hltwhs005.about: Recognise hazardous manual tasks and plan safer ways to prepare for and complete work.
short-hltwhs005.skills: Recognising hazards • Planning tasks • Safe work practices
short-hltwhs005.suit: Workers who perform manual handling as part of their duties.
short-hltwhs005.use: Apply safer task preparation and completion in an existing workplace role.
short-hltwhs005.jobs: Useful across care and other manual-work roles; additional role qualifications may be required.

short-hltaid009.about: Develop practical CPR skills through a short unit with online preparation and supervised learning.
short-hltaid009.skills: Emergency recognition • CPR practice • Responding within your training
short-hltaid009.suit: People seeking CPR training for personal or workplace needs.
short-hltaid009.use: Build confidence for emergency response within the scope of your training.
short-hltaid009.jobs: A supporting skill for many workplace roles; it is not a standalone healthcare qualification.

short-hltaid010.about: Explore basic emergency life-support skills through online preparation and practical learning.
short-hltaid010.skills: Emergency response • Basic life support • Practical preparation
short-hltaid010.suit: People who want basic emergency-response training for everyday or workplace settings.
short-hltaid010.use: Support emergency preparedness alongside workplace response procedures.
short-hltaid010.jobs: A supporting skill across workplace roles; it does not qualify a person as a paramedic.

short-hltaid011.about: Build first-aid knowledge and practical response skills for everyday and workplace situations.
short-hltaid011.skills: First-aid preparation • Practical response • Workplace readiness
short-hltaid011.suit: People seeking first-aid skills or meeting role-specific training requirements.
short-hltaid011.use: Support safer everyday and workplace environments within the scope of your training.
short-hltaid011.jobs: A supporting skill for many jobs; additional occupational qualifications may be needed.
